operations.details: Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium PipelineML Conceptual and Encoding Model page.
Pipeline-system geometry separated from parcel terrain observation.
Pipeline survey context not promoted to unrelated parcel-height accuracy.
Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium Points of Interest (POI) page.
POI location separated from surveyed ground point.
POI descriptive metadata not promoted to elevation accuracy.
Terrain source and survey uncertainty remain independently required.
Both OGC PipelineML and OGC POI URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No service/model/encoding value substituted for parcel terrain measurement without independent lineage.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
